description: Blocks Stop when a define-done report claims DONE but the contract does not check out.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/done-gate.py"; command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/done-gate.py"; echo "define-done gate: Python 3 not found - gate is OFF" >&2; exit 1
